review.rationale: WP03.00 canonical-host repair changes only Web hosting configuration and the reviewed artifact profile. An importless authored edge Worker redirects www to HTTPS apex before static assets; ASSETS fallback preserves apex behavior. Exact dependency declarations, lock closure, producer identities and package integrity remain unchanged. Browser resources r6 retains every r5 browser graph/template/legal/SBOM expectation and adds source-bound private Worker verification. This is not a dependency upgrade or broader source-reuse admission.
review.runtimeAssessment: No framework or package version changed. Worker-first routing executes the small authored redirect before static assets and delegates other hosts unchanged. The same-origin browser client and apex Cloud route remain intact. Local Node Request/Response navigation and asset fallback passed without network; hosted pinned-toolchain checks validate the final candidate. No real Cloud/browser round trip or local workerd execution is asserted.
review.maintenance: Current exact producer and package locks remain unchanged; dependency review and the existing high-severity audit remain required. Lockfile licence labels are metadata, not replacement file-level redistribution grants. Updates must refresh this reviewed input-bound record and pass applicable existing class checks.
review.immutableHistory: Admitted review records are retained in Git history. A dependency change requires a new reviewed source commit and updated input-bound rationale; never amend an already accepted provenance record.
